dct_title_s: Topographical map of the Reese River mines located in the vicinity of the town of Austin, Lander County, N.T.
dct_description_sm: Topographical map of mining claims, tunnels, shafts, quartz mills, roads, and related features in the Reese River mining district near Austin, Lander County, Nevada Territory. Includes explanations/legend, a scale bar in feet, and a table of distances from Austin.
